decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. The design of the Opus runner is the base of the compiler spec. Parts of the Sonnet design graft onto it. Where the synthesis and a runner disagree, the synthesis wins.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. The public surface of the compiler is compileStage and auditLibrary. One call makes one compile. No code outside src/compiler imports an internal file of the compiler.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. RuleRecord becomes a Zod discriminated union on kind. A shape rule carries shape. A code_check rule carries check with a name and params. A judgement rule carries judge.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. A scope selects the owner, the subtree of the owner, or one level in that subtree. A scope holds no node id. The virtual owner all holds the rules for every domain. The store refuses a node with the id all.
why: A rule cannot reach a parent or a sibling. So a rule at a foreign node cannot weaken an inherited rule.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. Shapes use a closed language with four types: text, number, flag, and list. The path syntax makes the containers. The language has no refine. The printer uses only constructs that z.toJSONSchema shows in full.
why: z.toJSONSchema drops a refine in silence, and the hash reads its output.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. One strictness order table for each parameter drives the meet of shapes and the weaken test.
why: Composition and weakening then read one definition, so they cannot disagree.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. Each inherited rule always applies, and a child rule never overrides it. A child weakens a rule when it restates the slot of that rule more loosely. Looser means a looser dimension that both rules set, or a lower binding. A dimension that only the child sets is an addition.
why: graph.scope forbids a child to weaken an inherited rule. A loose restatement also contradicts the prompt.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. Shape composition is the meet for each path of the shape rules in scope, over a trie. A conflict fails at compile time and names both rules. The compiler refuses a stage with no shape rule.
why: A conflict that reaches a run gives a schema that no output can fill. An empty schema accepts any output.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. A check template follows the split of OPA Gatekeeper. The template holds the code and a strict parameter schema, and a rule gives the values. A pass carries what it saw, and a fail carries the fix. FactKind is a closed list. The first templates are quote_in_source, key_in_registry, record_exists, and unique_by.
why: Code may verify facts but never grade or match (rules.harness). A check cannot express a number, a grade, or a match.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. RunEvidence types the evidence that a run gives, with the sources, the attribute keys, and the record ids. Golden example inputs use the same type.
why: The loader checks golden inputs, and a check reads only typed evidence.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. Only admit makes the Admitted value. A library with a problem gets a refusal. Derived rows get a new parse and a new hash, and their columns must agree with their records. The compiler refuses a derived shape rule and a derived id equal to a stage rule id.
why: Only Rohan changes an output shape (the row of 2026-10-24 on what an editor may change). A stored row can differ from what the stage wrote.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. The ledger has one entry for each input rule version, with a disposition. The dispositions include applied, draft, retired, superseded, and owner_not_on_path.
why: A rule that drops out of a compile leaves a trace.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. The code scorer applies one policy that no template can bypass. An absent field gives fail for a shape rule and cannot_verify for other rules. An existing empty list gives pass with observed []. Missing evidence or a throw gives cannot_verify. A judge maps yes, no, and unknown to pass, fail, and cannot_verify.
why: A check with no evidence never passes (rules.harness).

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. Only plan.scorers.judges(model) makes judge scorers, and the compile takes no model. A Vitest setup file stubs fetch to throw. Judge tests use createMockModel.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. The rule-set hash is the sha256 of the RFC 8785 JSON of a manifest of the compiled artifacts. The node id stays out of the hash.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. The file src/compiler/code.lock.json maps each declared code version to a fingerprint of its source. The file only grows. A test fails when a fingerprint moves under an unchanged version. A template file imports only zod and ./define.
why: The runtime hash reads declared versions, so tsx and a bundle agree. The lock proves that each version moved with its code.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. A statement or a reason that holds a parameter literal as a whole word gives a loader problem.
why: The params object then holds the only copy of each parameter, so the prompt and the check cannot drift.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. Watch rules never print and never shape the schema. Judge questions never print.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. The workflow compiles again in each step and compares the hash with the hash of the run. A mismatch stops the run.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. Each shape rule is strict. A shape rule with another binding gives a loader problem. The binding part of the weaken test applies to code checks only.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. Each check template ships test vectors. They hold a pass, a fail, and a cannot_verify when the template needs evidence. A conformance test proves each order table sound over the vectors.

result: docs/design/compiler.md (compile.weaken, compile.checks). For Rohan to review.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. The ledger is a partition. The applied, trial, and excluded entries together equal the input, and each version occurs once.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. Each test name starts with the name of its hazard, such as noop, drift, or weaken.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. Check params have no default values, so the authored params equal the parsed params. A test checks this.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. The hash holds no digest of check behavior over the vectors, as the Sonnet design did.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. JSON Schema is not the shape language. Both runners rejected it.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the architect synthesis. The compiler uses no override cascade, as in ESLint or CSS. Both runners rejected it.

decision: Claude decided for Rohan in the interrogate run. The rule hash covers owner, as well as shape and the structured check (record.owner_in_hash).
